## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Keep independent changes in separate commits.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes.
- [ ] Changed behavior and failure cases have meaningful regression coverage.
- [ ] Docker/resource changes pass `pnpm check:image`, when applicable.

State what was simulated, what was tested with a real provider, and any remaining limitations.

## Compatibility

Describe any changes to public tools, configuration, plugin installation or persisted state.
Include migration/rollback steps when needed. Confirm that no credentials or private transcripts are included.
